bio: Located in the heart of the UK, in rural Northamptonshire, Whittlebury Hall is the perfect location for an elegant and traditional Afternoon Tea.  Afternoon Tea is served in the Hotel's Silverstone Bar, and includes warm home baked scones, a range of savoury items, a selection of cakes and pastries and of course a choice of tea or coffee.  Whittlebury Hall is an idyllic retreat, where guests can enjoy spa facilities, access to the golf course and a sumptuous Afternoon Tea treat.
